articles.availability_note: Catch-up edition: prepared for 2026-11-08; first published November 13, 2026. NASA’s November 7 announcement concerns development and delivery of a future mission. Late-2028 launch and an 18-month primary mission are targets. Hardware comes from Earth-based Mars-rover spares and test systems. The $94 million delivery base and optional $140 million are distinct from total rover cost or actual spending. Ice distribution, extractability, savings and lunar performance remain to be established by appropriate evidence.
